title: Response and variation mechanisms of RDX crystals under strong magnetic loading
content:

To fully understand the variation in performance of cyclotrimethylenetrinitramine (RDX) crystals under strong magnetic field exposure, the strong magnetic loading of RDX was conducted in both stable and alternating magnetic fields.
